notes.title: Resident Evil 6 Update Released
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6
----------------------------------------------------------
NEW FEATURES
- Implementation of Anti-Cheating system


BUG FIXES
- Stability of Windows XP without WMP

- Change in voice chat function in Agent Hunt Mode

　A number of other issues have also been fixed.
----------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Resident Evil 6 Update Released
notes.content:
Version 1.0.4
----------------------------------------------------------

- Improved SLI performance with NVIDIA graphics cards

A number of other issues have also been fixed.

notes.title: Resident Evil 6 Update Released
notes.content:
Version 1.03
----------------------------------------------------------

BUG FIXES
- Fixed responses to commands given by partners in co-op.
- Fixed the display issue with the "Ustanak 1" action figure in Collections
- Fixed the difficulty level during the Haos battle in Chris’ campaign, chapter 5-3
- Fixed the input problem when using gamepads during the J'avo car chase scene in Chris’ campaign, chapter 3-6
- Fixed the issue where the player is unable to go through the door in Jake’s campaign, chapter 4-4

A number of other issues have also been fixed.
----------------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Resident Evil 6 X L4D2 Update Released
notes.content:
“Characters from Left 4 Dead™ 2 have invaded Resident Evil™ 6!

Owners of Resident Evil 6 on Steam are able to select one of four survivors from Left 4 Dead 2’s iconic cast – Coach, Ellis, Nick and Rochelle – when playing PC exclusive mode, The Mercenaries Unlimited No Mercy. Each character will have a special customized weapon load-out created just for use in Resident Evil 6. In addition to the four survivors, infamous Special Infected zombies from the Left 4 Dead franchise will also make a cameo appearance in this mode, relentlessly attacking players regardless of whether a character from Left 4 Dead 2 or Resident Evil 6 is chosen. This new and exclusive content will automatically be downloaded in the background to all owners of the PC version of Resident Evil 6. Have fun!”

notes.title: Update on RE6 Technical Issues (and a gift!)
notes.content:
First and foremost, thank you for purchasing Resident Evil 6.

More importantly, we'd like to express our apologies for any technical issues that have inconvenienced some users following its release.  Our teams are currently examining the cause of these issues and are taking necessary steps to resolve them.

Current and future title update announcements will be available under "[url=http://store.steampowered.com/news/?feed=steam_updates&appids=221040]View update history[/url]" on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/221040]Store Page[/url] as we add new features (L4D2!) and implement fixes.

Please know that we are taking all necessary measures to ensure that our fans will be able to have the best Resident Evil 6 experience possible, and that we greatly appreciate both your patience and support at this time.

To show our gratitude, we have prepared the following [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/236080]Wallpaper Set[/url][/b] for you to download.

[b]RE6 / BH6: Wallpaper Set[/b]
- Main art: 9 items
- Character: 4 items
- Enemy:  7 items

[b]Screen Resolution:[/b]
- 2560 x 1600
- 1920 x 1080
- 1280 x 1024
- 1280 x 960

Note: Files are all created in uncompressed BMP format; hence the whopping ~500MB download size.

Downloaded wallpaper assets can be found in the following folder on your computer: [b]...Steam\steamapps\common\Resident Evil 6\RE6_BH6_Wallpaper_set[/b]

We hope you enjoy it!

Resident Evil 6 / Biohazard 6 Team
